notes: Summary: Alfred is a mid-market developer tools company building an IDE copilot for enterprise customers. Main ask = reproducible code completions for audits + low latency (<100ms median) for streaming inline completions.
Key quote from CTO: "We need to be able to pin exact model+config that produced a completion — auditability is non-negotiable."

Requirements (short): model/version pinning, reproducible sampling, rollout tooling (canary/gradual), eval gates before rollout, rollback/safety hooks, SSO and audit logs, optional Dedicated for p95 latency certainty.
- Latency targets: median <50ms for single-token streaming on warm sessions, p95 <120ms under 200 concurrent coder sessions.
- Throughput profile: ~250 active dev sessions during peak; each session streams 30-120 tokens/sec bursts.
- Reproducibility goals: ability to retrieve exact model binary + tokenizer + sampling params (temp, top_p, seed) that generated a completion; prefer deterministic sampling mode for security audits.
- Rollout plan desired: canary to 2-5% for 48 hours, automated eval gate (synthetic prompts + unit test-run), expand to 25% then 100% if metrics stable.
- Eval gate metrics: compilation success rate, unit-test pass delta <=0.5%, API error rate <0.1%, hallucinations per 1k completions <2, latency regression p95 <= +10%.
- Observability needed: per-route token breakdown, token cost per request, per-model trace IDs, ability to tag requests with build/commit ID for correlation.
- Canary failure criteria: test-suite regressions, hallucination spike, latency p95 > configured SLO OR >20% increase vs baseline.

- Desired features from Redwood: pinned model aliases (immutable), exportable eval results, canary routing by user cohort or route, rollback API, per-request metadata included in logs (commit id, user-id), signed attestations for model artifact hashes.
POC scope: 4 weeks. Week1 integrate SAML + key rotation. Week2 run seeded eval harness and smoke canary. Week3 expand canary to 25%, run synthetic stress. Week4 finalize runbook + SLA discussion.

Blocker notes: legal needs explicit retention window and ability to purge code snippets on request; internal infra team concerned about non-deterministic sampling in production causing flakiness in bug reproductions.

SE suggestions recorded: use low-temp deterministic beam or sampling with stored seed for reproducibility; use Redwood Optimize suggestions to pick quantization/profile for latency tradeoff; consider Dedicated pool for consistent p95.
